# Funny Jokes

> A clean, family-friendly joke blog. 116 original jokes, written in our own words, in 10 categories of 10 jokes each, plus 16 new classic jokes. New jokes are added slowly, 2 to 4 at a time. No dark or adult humour.

## Site
- Home: https://funnyjokeshub.vercel.app/
- About: https://funnyjokeshub.vercel.app/about.html
- Privacy Policy: https://funnyjokeshub.vercel.app/privacy-policy.html
- Contact: https://funnyjokeshub.vercel.app/contact.html
- Sitemap: https://funnyjokeshub.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## The 116 jokes
Total: exactly 116 jokes, numbered 1 to 116 on the home page.
- Short Jokes: jokes 1–10 (#short-jokes)
- Dad Jokes: jokes 11–20 (#dad-jokes)
- Knock-Knock Jokes: jokes 21–30 (#knock-knock-jokes)
- Funny One-Liners: jokes 31–40 (#funny-one-liners)
- Jokes for Kids: jokes 41–50 (#jokes-for-kids)
- Animal Jokes: jokes 51–60 (#animal-jokes)
- Food Jokes: jokes 61–70 (#food-jokes)
- Work & Office Jokes: jokes 71–80 (#work-office-jokes)
- School Jokes: jokes 81–90 (#school-jokes)
- Clean Classic Jokes: jokes 91–116 (#clean-classic-jokes)

## Categories
- Short Jokes: quick jokes you can tell in seconds.
- Dad Jokes: classic dad-style groaners.
- Knock-Knock Jokes: ten fresh knock-knock jokes.
- Funny One-Liners: one line, one laugh.
- Jokes for Kids: clean, gentle jokes for children.
- Animal Jokes: jokes from the animal kingdom.
- Food Jokes: jokes about bread, cheese, fruit, and more.
- Work & Office Jokes: clean office humour, safe to share at work.
- School Jokes: classroom jokes for students and teachers.
- Clean Classic Jokes: gentle, timeless jokes about the sun, the moon, rain, and gardens.

## Pages
- index.html: the 116 jokes, plus Table of Contents, Quick Answer, What Makes a Joke Funny, How to Tell a Joke, FAQ (7 questions), and Final Thoughts. Includes a copy button per joke, a search/filter box, and a random-joke button (script.js).
- about.html: about the site and how it grows.
- privacy-policy.html: privacy policy — the site collects no personal information.
- contact.html: contact form for joke suggestions. No email address is published on the site yet.
